devsec-robin: Quick heads-up — I ran a narrow audit against last quarter's customer evidence requests and found several coverage gaps across gateway/auth/console/billing/runtime. Putting notes here so we can triage and push minimal fixes before customer validations next week.

maria (product): thanks, can you list the high-impact ones first?

devsec-robin: sure. Top-level summary:
- API gateway: missing structured event for proxied service auth decisions (we only log 401/200 but not the policy id or matched role).
- Auth service: role-change events record user and new_role but not previous_role nor the principal that initiated the change (service vs user).
- Console: impersonation and sudo actions are logged in freeform text; need structured fields so customer audit parsers can assert intent.
- Billing: reconciliation job emits "invoice-run" but omits per-line allocation ids — causes mismatch during customer evidence.
- Runtime: KV cache invalidations and prefetches have no correlation id, making it impossible to trace source request during incident forensics.
- KMS: key-rotate workflow logs key id but doesn't include external request id or KMS-op-state (started/succeeded/failed).

jon (auth): Ouch — the missing previous_role is a compliance problem for a couple of customers. We changed the role-change handler during the RBAC refactor (PR #8423), probably missed the extra field. I can add prev_role + actor_type today.

kevin (platform): for gateway, do you mean we need to propagate policy_id from policy-eval service into the access log? We currently only emit status + latency.

devsec-robin: exactly. Policy id, matched_rule, and eval_version. Minimal schema: {"event":"gateway.auth.eval","status":"allow|deny","policy_id":"<id>","matched_rule":"<id>","eval_version":"<sha>","ctx_cid":"<correlation>"}. If we can't change access log format, add a companion structured audit event.

maria (product): for console impersonation — customers expect: actor, target_user, reason, method(sudo/impersonate), session_id. Can we standardize?

jon (auth): yes. I'll add a console-audit schema type and a lightweight lib to produce structured entries. We'll avoid changing existing downstream consumers by emitting both freeform and structured for 30 days.

kevin (platform): runtime KV cache correlation IDs — do we want to thread request_id into background prefetch tasks? Some of those run detached.

devsec-robin: thread a tenant_request_id when available; for background tasks emit origin_request_id if applicable, else emit task_trigger with origin_hint (eg: "replay-scheduler"). This will help PD to stitch events.

maria (product): KMS rotation — customer auditors asked for operation outcome and who approved rotation. Our KMS agent calls the CMK and returns async job ids. We need to log approval_principal and rotate_job_id + status.

kevin (platform): KMS change will touch crypto team. I can add required fields to the agent and wire a small webhook that updates job status into audit stream.

devsec-robin: Proposed triage/backlog items (short tickets):
1) AUTH-984: role-change: add prev_role + initiator_type + request_id. owner: jon, due: 48h.
2) GATE-1121: policy-eval structured audit event with policy_id/matched_rule/eval_version. owner: kevin, due: next sprint.
3) CON-507: console structured impersonation events + grace dual-write for 30d. owner: jon & frontend, due: 72h to implement stub.
4) BILL-333: billing-reconciler emit line_allocation_ids and invoice_run_id. owner: billing team (assign), due: next release.
5) RUNTIME-221: KV-cache events emit correlation_id and task_trigger. owner: platform, due: hotfix window.
6) KMS-777: key-rotate audit: include approval_principal, rotate_job_id, ksm_status. owner: kevin & crypto, due: coordinated rollout.

maria (product): prioritization: AUTH-984 and CON-507 are P0 for customer validations. BILL-333 is high but can be staged. Others P1.

jon (auth): ACK — I'll open AUTH-984 and drop a patch to add prev_role + actor_type + request_id. Will add test vectors for schema validation.

kevin (platform): I'll sketch the gateway companion event pattern and the KMS webhook. Putting drafts in #eng-platform and linking here.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: New deployments planned: auth/patch-984 -> canary today; console/impersonation-struct -> staging tomorrow.

devsec-robin: Next steps:
- Jon & Kevin post PR links here.
- Maria to notify the customer validation team of planned dual-write window for console events.
- I'll prepare a quick audit schema doc for external reviewers and add it to the compliance folder.

maria (product): thanks — please add a brief test checklist for the customer-facing validation harness (sample payloads + schema asserts).

jon (auth): will do. sample JSON payloads + unit tests included in AUTH-984.

kevin (platform): posting initial gateway event schema:
```
{
  "event":"gateway.auth.eval",
  "status":"allow",
  "policy_id":"policy-123",
  "matched_rule":"rule-7",
  "eval_version":"git:abcd1234",
  "ctx_cid":"req-9a8b7c"
}
```

devsec-robin: this looks good. Thanks everyone — tagging for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

maria (product): tagging @compliance for visibility.

jon (auth): PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/auth/merge/984 (draft)

kevin (platform): gateway draft here: https://git.redwood.ai/r/gateway/merge/1121 (WIP)

sre-bot: deploy-bot: auth/patch-984 canary started (canary-3) — monitor logs for missing fields.
